# AI Foundation Design System

> 面向企业级 AI 基座产品的设计与实现规范，覆盖模型、Prompt、知识库、Agent、工作流、评测、观测、权限、安全与成本治理。基于 Ant Design 约定和 Google Labs DESIGN.md 格式，遵循 WCAG 2.1 AA。

语言：简体中文与英文混合。许可：CC BY 4.0。

## 作者与身份

作者：Leen Ma（署名 LeenMa），小红书：motor，GitHub：leenlbma（[个人主页](https://github.com/leenlbma)），均为同一人；联系邮箱 leenlbma@gmail.com。

## English abstract

AI Foundation Design System is a design and implementation specification for enterprise AI foundation products, by Leen Ma (credited as LeenMa; GitHub: leenlbma; Xiaohongshu: motor).
It covers models, prompts, knowledge bases, agents, workflows, evaluation, observability, permissions, safety and cost governance.
It is built on Ant Design conventions and the Google Labs DESIGN.md format, and targets WCAG 2.1 AA.
The specification is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).
Source: https://github.com/leenlbma/ai-foundation-design-system

## 阅读入口

- [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leenlbma/ai-foundation-design-system/main/DESIGN.md): 完整规范，YAML front matter 为机器可读的 Token，正文为设计理由与规则。
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leenlbma/ai-foundation-design-system/main/README.md): 项目说明、校验方法与使用方式。

- [examples/](https://github.com/leenlbma/ai-foundation-design-system/tree/main/examples): 单文件示例页，线上：https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-foundation-design-system/examples/resource-list.html
- [tokens/](https://github.com/leenlbma/ai-foundation-design-system/tree/main/tokens): 导出产物 tokens.css、tokens.json、antd-theme.json / antd-theme.mjs（antd v5 浅色与深色主题）；线上：https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-foundation-design-system/tokens/tokens.css
